method.inputs: Only AGENTS.md, selection.json, NOTICE.md, rights JSON/receipt, eight rendered *.text.json responses, revision JSON and receipts. No wikitext captures, adapters, evaluators, tests, gold or other audit reports read. No network requests.
method.enumeration: Independently inspected all normalized rendered HTML table rows and source headers/cells. A standalone stdlib HTMLParser helper enumerated cells; the auditor reviewed every displayed film row. Raw markup separately checked the live-action tied-winner title annotations. No implementation output was consulted.
method.title_policy: Use displayed English/first title cell, preserving punctuation/case. Award TIE annotations outside italic titles are not title text. Alternative original-language title cells identify the same selection and are not separate records.
method.category_policy: Normalize rendered local heading by stripping markup; Academy tables additionally preserve displayed year plus award-edition subgroup after a slash. Rowspan-only year headers set subsequent film grouping.
method.rank_policy: All eight sections are unranked memberships/award nominees; rank and ordinal tie are null. Display order and award-win/tied-win annotations are distinct.
method.independence_limits: Independent automated enumeration of derivative Wikipedia renderings only; same publisher material is not independent critical evidence, a human audit, or original festival/Academy factual corroboration. API response hashes verify captured evidence consistency, not external authenticity or perpetual rendering stability.

rights.limits: Retained Wikipedia text and derived audit records use CC BY-SA 4.0 with pinned contributor attribution. No license for images, media, external primary pages or independent primary factual verification is inferred.
